name: Equipment Workshop
description: Three original procedural presentations of proven equipment layouts: Ukrainian garden heritage, a 1990s arcade circuit, and an abstract spend network. Optional Steady Thread, Power Circuit and Safe Reconcile seals demonstrate authored goals; every map also supports ordinary clears.

metadata.author: Reveal Line
metadata.rightsStatus: Original project content; abstract spend theme is not an official Coupa product or endorsement.

classRecipes.label: Scout
classRecipes.description: Mark hidden objectives permanently; show enemy direction hints for four seconds. No slowing.

classRecipes.label: Light carrier
classRecipes.description: Pick up one charge at a supply pad; drop a field that stuns nearby field enemies.

classRecipes.label: Heavy carrier
classRecipes.description: Carry two charges; each creates the same temporary stun field.

classRecipes.label: Interceptor
classRecipes.description: Absorb one enemy or lane contact: cancel the cut and recover at spawn without losing a life. Self-crossing remains dangerous.

classRecipes.label: Fiber relay
classRecipes.description: Ignore signal interference and scan for hidden relays. Your cable is the live trail: enemy contact still breaks it.

classRecipes.label: Impact craft
classRecipes.description: Release a close-range stun pulse, abandon the unfinished cut and redeploy at home without losing a life. The pulse never captures territory.

classRecipes.label: Trapper
classRecipes.description: Pick up one charge and place a four-second field that slows field enemies to one quarter speed.

metadata.title: Garden of Threads
metadata.description: Recommended: Fiber relay. Stitch both memory markers into the garden and reveal 72%. The broad-band region slows ordinary craft, while a resistant craft keeps its speed. For Steady Thread, close at least eight distinct live-cut cells inside active broad-band interference and finish without losing a life. A 12-second cut and 36-cell trail budget still apply.
metadata.author: Reveal Line
metadata.rightsStatus: Original teaching layout adapted from Homeward Skies; original procedural art and music.

metadata.title: Neon Switchboard
metadata.description: Recommended: Light carrier, then Heavy carrier. Reconnect both cartridge markers and reveal 68%. Power Circuit asks you to refill at both docks, close a cut through two suppressed cells in each emitter region, and switch to Heavy carrier at the southern hangar. Each cut has a 6.5-second budget. All classes can attempt an ordinary clear without this optional seal.
metadata.author: Reveal Line
metadata.rightsStatus: Original teaching layout adapted from Homeward Skies; original procedural art and music.

metadata.title: Clear Ledger
metadata.description: Recommended: Impact craft. Uncover the opportunity marker and reveal 70% before the 35-second timer expires. Safe Reconcile asks you to pulse from a live cut of at least three cells, stun the cable-cutter, return home, then finish with every life. The pulse abandons the cut; it does not claim territory. An ordinary clear remains available.
metadata.author: Reveal Line
metadata.rightsStatus: Original teaching layout adapted from Homeward Skies; original procedural art and music.

masteries.name: Steady Thread
masteries.description: Close one cut through eight distinct interference cells with signal resistance, then win without losing a life.

masteries.name: Power Circuit
masteries.description: Refill at both supply pads, close a cut through two suppressed cells in each emitter region, switch to Heavy carrier at the southern hangar, then win.

masteries.name: Safe Reconcile
masteries.description: Use an impact pulse from a live cut of at least three cells to stun the cable-cutter, return home, then win without losing a life.
